# ADO208: template-limits

Template includes form a cycle or exceed documented limits.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Category** | Templates and parameters |
| **Default severity** | error |
| **Enabled by default** | yes |
| **Checked on** | template expansion |

## Description

Azure Pipelines allows at most 100 separate template files and 100 levels of nesting. Templates can't include themselves directly or indirectly.

## Example

Problem:

```yaml
# a.yml includes b.yml, which includes a.yml
```

Instead:

```yaml
# Break the cycle by moving shared content to a third template.
```

## Configuration

Change the severity or turn the rule off in `.adolint.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  ADO208: off   # off | info | warning | error
```

Or on the command line: `adolint lint --disable ADO208` or `--enable ADO208`.

Suppress a single finding with a comment on the line before it (or `disable-line` at the end of the line):

```yaml
# adolint:disable-next-line ADO208
```

Questions about ADO208, or a false positive? [Open an issue](https://github.com/danielsada/go-ado-pipelines-lint/issues/new?title=ADO208%3A+) with the YAML that triggered it.
